summary: Iter84 Align Assistant — backend and frontend tested. Backend: all 6 pytest cases pass (triggers auth+shape, case-brief valid+404, chat SSE streams + saves history, empty→400, multi-turn coherent reply). Frontend on /dashboard as admin (mattsossi@bsossi.com / AlignTemp2026!): all required data-testids render (pro-hero, primary-cta-bar with 3 CTAs, pipeline-stepper with pipeline-case-select and 5 pipeline-step-* with data-state, pro-top-nav with case-lookup-input, active-cases-count showing 'Active Cases (3)', new-case-btn). Case Lookup with valid code SA-26-COP-ERX538 navigates to /joint/:id; unknown code shows sonner error toast. cta-invite-parents navigates to /joint/new. More tools <details> still contains primary-actions-grid. Assistant: hovering cta-review-joint then opening assistant-open-btn reveals assistant-chip-review; clicking chip streams a coherent 136-char reply from Gemini 3 Flash within ~20s. Closing and reopening panel retains history. No horizontal overflow at 1920 or 390 widths. Regression /samples/legal-lens-report renders 12 sections / 21 headings (≥11 as expected).

design_issues.screen: Dashboard (all pages using selects with computed option text)
issues: React hydration console warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option>. Caused by Emergent's dev-tooling injecting an x-source-editable <span> wrapper inside computed <option> text (see PipelineStepper.jsx:21). Harmless in production but pollutes dev console.

critical_code_review_comments: assistant.py chat handler stores the user message BEFORE the LLM call and only stores the assistant reply after the stream closes. If the client disconnects mid-stream, we get an orphan user message with no assistant reply — history shows an unbalanced turn. Consider storing partial reply on cancellation.

AlignAssistant.jsx: send() catches errors but leaves the last placeholder assistant bubble in state with the error text; the SSE server actually emits {error: '...'} deltas which get concatenated on top of any prior partial reply. Fine, but the fallback error message text is not persisted to DB (only 'reply' from successful stream is saved).

PipelineStepper LINKS[s.key](selectedId) will throw if selectedId is null; guarded by early return on !cases.length but not on !selectedId when brief has stale steps — currently safe because brief is cleared on selectedId change, but fragile.

ProTopNav case-lookup does substring match on case_code and case_reference; harmless UX pattern but note it's not the exact-match promised by the spec (spec says typing existing case code + Enter navigates).
